styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, flat sky-blue #6CC1E8 colour blocks for benefit and infographic screens, warm off-white #F7F3EC ledges and real stone or concrete surfaces for lifestyle scenes, always with one diagonal hatch stripe motif on an outer edge
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light, front-left key with bounce fill, gentle contact shadows; scenes lit by overcast or window daylight around 5200-6000K with a single consistent light direction
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white counter #FFFFFF, warm grey stone paving #C8C0B4, warm matte concrete wall #DAD3C6
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif scaffolding only; rendered in-image copy is stripped, headline and label positions stay as blank rule lines
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line single-colour pictograms inside plain circular discs, uniform stroke weight, no gradients, no filled 3d badges
styleLock.presentationRules: upright vessel kept at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle with constant scale across the set; lid and folding spoon may be shown detached or nested but never covering the body; product never clipped by the frame
noDrift: no rendered brand marks or legible invented copy
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean bright kid-tableware ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm off-white #F7F3EC, one sky-blue accent block #6CC1E8 and charcoal text #2E3440; neutral high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadows, lifestyle screens lit by soft 5200-6000K daylight from one direction; modern geometric sans-serif used only as blank layout scaffolding with headline and label positions left empty; thin-line single-colour icons inside plain circular discs; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements such as blank callout lines, empty badge discs and unnumbered dimension brackets; stable upright product angle and constant product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

Bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left softbox key with a white bounce card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no scenery, no horizon. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 1:1 square, commercial packshot sharpness. Negative: no props, no hands, no people, no watermark, no badge or star ratings, no brand mark or lettering on the body, no extra text, no gradient or coloured background, no cut-off lid or base, no floating product without contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 纯白底直立机身，一侧夹附折叠勺；002 白底信息图，顶部蓝色标题带＋左右无数字尺寸括号＋右侧四条卖点条目；003 操场石板地景，午餐袋与小盒摆在地面，两名儿童全身入镜，下方蓝色色块大字主张；004 正上方俯拍广口，罐内盛切块瓜果，左列三枚圆底细线图标配文字条目；005 课桌前开盖立勺、盖体另置，上方蓝色标题带与两枚圆徽章图标；006 蓝色底并列三件同家族器皿与折叠勺，下方大段文字区；007 暖调水泥墙前儿童双手抱罐，左半为大字排版区。品类判定依据：源类目仅作线索，判定以图为准——全套由操场、课桌、午餐袋与同家族多器型选款驱动，购买者是替孩子备午餐的家长，情感驱动强于器型驱动，故归母婴/喂养（儿童保温食物罐），而非家居日用/水具餐具。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列名、原平台店铺字样、平台徽章与星级角标、全部图内英文标语与原句、尺寸数值与冷热时长数值、材质与检测类主张、可辨识童模面容（改为颈下裁切或背影）；产品一律以 {product} 占位，原数值与主张改为空白指示条、空徽章框与无数字尺寸括号。
